params.name: catalog_name
params.description: Name of catalog used to generate the report. A catalog or project is needed if a report ID was not provided.

params.name: projects[]
params.description:
Names of projects to filter by. Currently only used for the following reports:

* all_projects_compliance
* all_projects_package_quality
* all_projects_violations
* license_attribution
* release_usage

params.name: report_type
params.description:
Type of report

 - [all_projects_compliance (compliance of projects to catalog standards)](https://support.tidelift.com/hc/en-us/articles/24885171849236)
 - [all_projects_package_quality (Tidelift recommendations by package)](https://support.tidelift.com/hc/en-us/articles/24971666742932)
 - [all_projects_violations (All projects violations)](https://support.tidelift.com/hc/en-us/articles/24883174701332)
 - catalog_activity_audit (Catalog Activity)
 - eol_impact (End of life)
 - license_attribution (License attribution)
 - release_usage (Catalog-wide open source use)

params.name: catalog_standards[]
params.description: Catalog Standards to filter by (only supported by all_projects_violations)
